decision: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — Frozen decision_rule triggers FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING: null control passes for both KDE (8/8) and kNN (8/8) at lambda=0, but CV ≤0.5 at lambda=1 fails for both KDE (max 0.5745 on type 4, 7/8 pass) and kNN (max 0.5750 on type 0, 7/8 pass). Positive controls pass strongly (KDE t=7.81 p=0.0007, kNN t=6.82 p=0.0012). The frozen rule requires ALL conditions for BOTH measures; CV failure on one type per measure is sufficient. The result is a valid scientific negative on per-type stability at 250/type, not measurement invalidity. Audit PASS confirms all recomputed metrics match producer. Claim ceiling bounded to: KDE and kNN achieve per-type null control (8/8 pass) where binned TV fails (4/8 pass), confirming the binned TV false-positive is estimator-specific; however, per-type CV stability ≤0.5 is not achieved at 250/type by either KDE (max 0.575, marginal) or kNN (max 0.755, substantial). All evidence remains synthetic 2D [0,1]^2 with 8 heterogeneous affine page types; no inference to real Web DOM dynamics warranted.

claim_updates.reason: No change to claim status. This experiment provides one disambiguation: the binned TV per-type false-positive (4/8 null fail in parent EXP-FRONTIER-34881708619) is estimator-specific, not general to density-divergence estimation — KDE and kNN both achieve 8/8 null control at 250/type. However, per-type CV stability (≤0.5 at lambda=1) fails for both KDE (max 0.575 type 4) and kNN (max 0.755 type 0), triggering frozen FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING. The per-type stability limitation generalizes beyond binning to sample-size/heterogeneity at 250/type. All evidence remains synthetic 2D [0,1]^2; no inference to real Web dynamics justified. The exploratory kNN k=10 CV pass (max 0.470, 8/8) is hypothesis-generating only per prereg §14 and cannot support confirmatory claims.

product_action: No product action. Per-type density-divergence at 250/type is not justified with current estimators (KDE Scott, kNN k=5) under frozen stability criterion. Pooled estimation remains required. The binned TV sparse-binning diagnosis is validated (null now passes with binning-free estimators), confirming the recommendation to not repeat binned TV. Exploratory kNN k=10 pass requires new preregistration before any product consideration.
next_question: Does per-type CV stability (≤0.5 at lambda=1) achieve at larger per-type n (500-1000/type) with KDE Scott or kNN k=5, or does kNN k=10 (EXPLORATORY CV pass max 0.470 at 250/type) survive confirmatory preregistration — and does the per-type vs pooled ordering reversal (KDE/kNN per-type>pooled vs binned pooled>per-type) persist across DGP families with different noise structures?
